A '''detoxification hypo''', sometimes shortened to '''Detox hypo'''<ref name=":0">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>, was part of a [[radiation zone assault trooper]]'s standard survival equipment.<ref name=":1">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref><ref name=":0" /> It was often stored on the utility belt<ref name=":0" /> and supplied in case a hot zone was encountered unexpectedly.<ref name=":1" />
